escalation.obstacle: (W) at k = 6, in its sharpest surviving form: in the singleton class S_1, prove that the 3-cycle locus has no accumulation point (equivalently, by m4 Theorem 3, that L is locally finite). Nothing weaker is consumed by the printed argument (m5's punctured-annulus counterexample kills every size/content/porosity substitute) and nothing stronger is needed.
escalation.definitions: c : R^2 -> [6] a.e.-measurable with, for every ball B, int_B int_{S^1} 1_{A_i}(x) 1_{A_i}(x+u) dsigma(u) dx = 0 for all i (weak measurability, paper Def. 1.2). W_x = weak-* limits of (a_i(y_n + r_n e)) over typical circle samplings y_n -> x, r_n -> 1 (Def. 5.1); P_x(e) = {i : e in D_{x,i}} with D_{x,i} the essential union of {b_i > 0}. Gamma_x has edge ij iff limsup_{h->0} D_ij(B,h)/|h| > 0 for every ball B around x (Def. 6.1). L = {x : Gamma_x contains a cycle}. S_1 = the class where |P_x(e)| = 1 for a.e. e at every x.
escalation.hypotheses: Weak measurability only, plus membership in S_1; no regularity, no periodicity, no boundedness. The class S_1 is nonempty in the contradiction setting (it contains every cell-constant colouring with piecewise C^1 boundaries) but its nonemptiness at k = 6 is exactly the existence of a 6-colouring, so any proof must be usable inside a reductio.
escalation.attempted_approaches: Palette-level models for every cycle length (killed: Theorem C, uniform pair field); centre-independent fields (killed: T2 endpoint trace, m4 Cor 2); finite two-centre CSP (collapses to a 7-chromatic finite unit-distance graph, m10); size/content/porosity conditions on L (killed by m5's punctured annulus and perfect zero-content set); the isolation constants (settled: window 1 < rho <= 2, sharp threshold R > 1); self-avoidance (now proved, this block, so it is available as an input); the printed triangle case (needs |P| <= 2, unavailable at k = 6 where m1's single-centre system excludes only K_6).
escalation.expected_useful_output: Either a proof that at k = 6 the 3-cycle locus is locally finite in S_1, which by m4 Theorem 3 and Theorem A makes §7 available at six colours (and would still need a new §8-at-6 to give chi >= 7), or an explicit S_1 model at k = 6 whose 3-cycle locus accumulates, which refutes (W) inside the only class where a colouring-level proof could live. A weaker acceptable output: a proof that a 3-cycle centre with |P_x(e)| = 3 on a positive-measure arc cannot have unit-distance neighbours whose palettes are ternary in a common direction, i.e. a genuine use of m2's |P_x|+|P_y| <= 5 beyond the pointwise level.
